svg.title: Table: Graphicle 0.1.1 against Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) and Claude Code alone. Speed on 13 codebases, Graphicle's 0.1.1 memory engine (pre-release) against Graphify 0.9.91, same machine, 3 CPUs each, graphs differ slightly: less time in 39 of 39 measurements, 3.0× to 22.7×; Kubernetes extract 1 min 8 s against 25 min 47 s. Published same-graph run, 0.1.0 engine against Graphify 0.9.88: 3 min 18 s against 26 min 38 s. Updates after a commit (0.1.0): 6 to 8× less time. Kubernetes peak memory, Graphicle 0.1.1: 2,148 MiB against 2,767 MiB; lower in 39 of 39 measurements. Coding agents: on Graphify's showcase corpus Graphicle found 99.2% of the facts, Graphify 87.8% (+11.4 pts), Claude Code alone 94.7% (a tie); median tokens: Graphicle 69.2k, Graphify 87.1k, Claude Code alone 60.8k; fewer than Graphify, no difference measured against Claude Code alone. Never-seen commits, SWE-bench Verified, our own project: ties.
svg.desc: Graphicle 0.1.1 against Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) and Claude Code alone. Speed and memory (one Linux node per test; the Graphicle build is named on each row): Speed on 13 codebases × 3 operations: Graphicle 0.1.1 39 of 39 3.0× to 22.7× less time; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 0 of 39; Claude Code alone -. Kubernetes extract, in that run: Graphicle 0.1.1 1 min 8 s 22.7× less time; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 25 min 47 s; Claude Code alone -. Kubernetes extract, same graph: Graphicle 0.1.1 3 min 18 s 8.1× less time on this run; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 26 min 38 s Graphify 0.9.88; Claude Code alone -. Update after a commit: Graphicle 0.1.1 5.7 · 2.1 · 1.6 s 6 to 8× less time; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 34.6 · 13.0 · 13.1 s; Claude Code alone -. Peak memory: Kubernetes build: Graphicle 0.1.1 2,148 MiB 0.78× of Graphify's peak; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 2,767 MiB; Claude Code alone -. Peak memory: 13 repositories × 3 operations: Graphicle 0.1.1 39 of 39 0.29× to 0.97× of Graphify's peak; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 0 of 39; Claude Code alone -. Memory checks (Graphicle only): Stale-memory flags on notes tied to code: Graphicle 0.1.1 15 of 15 changed notes flagged 0 false flags; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) -; Claude Code alone -. Coding agents (Claude Code 2.1.287, Opus 5.5, effort medium, one run per task): Graphify's showcase corpus: facts found: Graphicle 0.1.1 99.2%; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 87.8% [Graphicle +11.4 pts] 95% CI [4.2, 19.7]; Claude Code alone 94.7% [tie]. Same test: tokens per answer: Graphicle 0.1.1 69.2k mean 81.8k; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 87.1k mean 113.5k [Graphicle −31.8k] 95% CI [−58.9k, −8.2k]; Claude Code alone 60.8k mean 183.7k [no difference measured]. Never-seen private commits: all files found: Graphicle 0.1.1 57.0%; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 58.1% [tie]; Claude Code alone 57.0% [tie]. SWE-bench Verified: all files found: Graphicle 0.1.1 95%; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 94% [tie]; Claude Code alone 95% [tie]. Questions about our own project: facts found: Graphicle 0.1.1 97.1%; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) 98.5% [tie]; Claude Code alone 97.4% [tie]. Never-seen, with Haiku 5.5: all files found: Graphicle 0.1.1 43.0%; Graphify 0.9.91 (Python) not run; Claude Code alone 38.7% [tie]. Tests run 14 and 15 Oct 2026. Coding agents: Claude Code 2.1.287, Opus 5.5, effort medium (Haiku row: Claude Code 2.1.300); paired differences with 95% bootstrap CIs. Speed and memory: one Linux node per test (Intel Xeon Platinum 8480C). The 13-codebase rows are one session per program, run one after the other on 15 Oct 2026, not interleaved. Ties are shown as ties. Method and published results: github.com/graphicle-ai/graphicle/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md Not in that page's tables: the 0.1.1 token check on 50 SWE-bench tasks, which comes from our run records.
